pages.text: A basic cultivation attack that condenses magicules into a small fireball and launches it along your line of sight.

$(bold)Type:$() Intrinsic Skill$(br)$(bold)Cost:$() 50 magicules$(br)$(bold)Cooldown:$() 8 seconds$(br2)The fireball flies quickly, explodes on impact with an entity or block, has about 2 explosion power, and deals fire damage on direct hits. It also explodes after about 5 seconds or around 50 blocks of travel.
